theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let two finite source sets be value-preservingly enumerated by actual arrays of lengths $N_L,N_R$, with stored histograms for zero and selected shifts. Fix local parameters $h,J$, cutoff at most $464hJ$, and a family of global output records. Suppose their occurrence rows and the exact selected-cover input are stored before the bank base; all maps, candidate and histogram inputs precede that base; and the concrete interface and stated space, word, address, and depth bounds hold. The batch constructs both exact stored source-stage families and headers for every requested bank in its stated time, preserving the input prefix.

Builds reusable source transforms once per occurrence vector. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
